title: Wedding Rings
author: GromDesign
description:
Make your things unique!
This creative embroidery will decorate your clothes and interior items. You can choose the color scheme at your discretion. The right selection of materials for embroidery will ensure the good quality of your embroidered products. This machine embroidery design comes with multiple embroidery file formats and can be used with multiple embroidery machines.
